node.statement: Let K_0,e_0 and K_1,e_1 be the universal constants furnished by nodes 1.1.1 and 1.1.2. Since e=delta+epsilon>=0, replacing K_i by K_i^+:=max(K_i,0) preserves both estimates; relabel these nonnegative finite constants as K_i. Put S:=K_0+K_1 and choose e_u:=min(e_0,e_1,1/(2*S)) if S>0, while e_u:=min(e_0,e_1) if S=0. Then e_u>0. For e<=e_u, the validated dependencies 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 give ||Q||>=1-K_0*e and ||tilde Q-Q||<=K_1*e. Hence, using u_Q=tilde Q, the reverse triangle inequality yields ||u_Q||=||tilde Q||>=||Q||-||tilde Q-Q||>=1-S*e>=1/2 (and equals the bound 1 when S=0). Thus c_u:=1/2 proves node 1.1.3 and its parent nondegeneracy conclusion once those dependencies are validated.
